rota_core.config.player_color.desc: Defines the player identity visual color for map markers, spyglass holographic silhouettes, and diegetic bars.
rota_core.config.player_color.tip: Client cosmetic option. Choose among the 16 classic Minecraft dye colors.
rota_core.config.naming_style.title: Naming Style (Zones & Routes)
rota_core.config.naming_style.subtitle: Geopolitical and route naming standard
Immersive medieval names such as Kingdoms, Baronies, and Royal Roads.
rota_core.config.naming.numeric_sector.d: Tactical and ordered nomenclature, such as Zone 01, Route 04, and Sector A.
rota_core.config.naming.geographic.desc: Descriptive names based on terrain landforms, biomes, and cardinal directions.
rota_core.config.naming.disabled.desc: No procedural names generated for routes or provinces.
rota_core.config.road_curvature.title: Road Curvature Mode
rota_core.config.road_curvature.subtitle: Topographic stiffness and mountain switchbacks
rota_core.config.curvature.direct.desc: Prioritizes shortest distance with minimal curves, accepting steeper cuts and fills.
rota_core.config.curvature.balanced.desc: Balance between distance and terrain, bypassing high mountains and ravines.
rota_core.config.curvature.serpentine.de: Strict contour following with S-curve switchbacks and gradual step distribution.
rota_core.config.curvature.rule_step: Slope Gauge: Strict maximum slope of 0.5 blocks per meter (Solid -> Slab -> Solid).
rota_core.config.curvature.rule_plateau: Step Distribution: Flat horizontal plateaus distributed across gentle slopes.
rota_core.config.curvature.rule_bridge: Bridge Leveling: Straight flat deck at safe horizontal elevation (seaLevel + 2).
